newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN SEDGWICK UNIT 1996 PROFIT JUMPS.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN SEDGWICK UNIT 1996 PROFIT JUMPS.

text.p: Belgium's largest insurance brokerage Thilly Van Eessel, a subsidiary of the London-quoted Sedgwick group, said on Tuesday 1996 net profit jumped 12.7 percent to 85.3 million francs partly due to a stronger dollar.
Turnover rose by 2.4 percent to 1.57 billion francs despite the relatively unfavourable economic climate.

Earnings were bolstered by the dollar, strong commercial results and cost control, which outweighed a weak economic climate which inflated the number of bankruptcies, low interest rates, a wage freeze and downward pressure on premiums following overcapacity. -- Bert Lauwers, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6815
